title: Existence of solutions for an interaction problem between a bubble and a compressible viscous fluid
summary: In this paper, we study the dynamics of a finite number of spherical bubbles in a compressible fluid within a bounded open domain of R 3 . The fluid-bubble interaction is described by a system of nonlinear partial differential equations (PDEs) and ordinary differential equations (ODEs) coupling the fluid's density, velocity and pressure to the bubble's translational, rotational and radial velocities.
